title: nf-hello pipeline parameters
description: Options for the text-only greeting example pipeline.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Choose the text file included in each greeting output.

input_file.description: Path to a text file copied into every greeting output. Defaults to the example file bundled with the pipeline.

greeting_options.title: Greeting options
greeting_options.description: Set the recipient and tone for each greeting.

recipient.description: Name or phrase addressed by each greeting.

tone.description: Punctuation used at the end of each greeting: exclamation mark, full stop, or question mark.

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Add a numeric label and choose the letter case of each greeting.

run_number.description: Numeric label written to every greeting file.

uppercase.description: Convert the greeting line to uppercase.
